EmailTemplate.description: SignZero passcode email. Edit freely, or clone it and set the copy in SignZero Email Templates. Keep the [[...]] placeholders SignZero fills in; see the technical guide.
EmailTemplate.name: SignZero Passcode
EmailTemplate.subject: Your code to open [[DocumentName]]
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [[SignerName]],
Use this code to open "[[DocumentName]]":
[[Passcode]]
The code expires in [[PasscodeMinutes]] minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email: nobody can open the document without it.
